svg.title: Defense in depth for agent sandbox egress
svg.desc: An agent workload is isolated below the guest kernel, sends outbound traffic through a host-controlled default-deny egress gateway with destination and DNS policy, and produces write and policy-decision telemetry for response.
svg.text: Put policy outside the workload it constrains
Isolation, outbound authorization, and response are separate controls with separate failure modes.
Log principal, destination, and policy decision.
Alert on unexpected writes; stop the run under your response policy.
Design guidance, not a claim that any single control guarantees containment.
